## §5.1.1: The *Hypersyntrix* ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}$) & *Hypermetrophor* Encapsulation {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: HISTORICAL EXEGESIS (SM, PP. 80–83, EQS. 20, 20a, 20b)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Crossing the Scale Threshold: *Hyperkategorien*
* Chapters 1–4 traced base-level Syntrices ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 0}{\mathbf{M}} \equiv \mathbf{y}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}}$), but nature and cognition are **irreducibly multi-scale**: an entire network at scale $n$ becomes a single elementary building block at scale $n+1$.
* In §5.1 (SM, p. 81), Heim constructs the **Metroplex ersten Grades**—the **Hypersyntrix ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}$)**:
$$
\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \;\equiv\; \big\langle\langle \underline{\mathrm{F}},\, \widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \rangle \underline{\mathrm{r}} \big\rangle \quad \lor \quad \widetilde{\mathrm{a}}| \;\equiv\; (\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}_i)_N \tag{SM-20}
$$

::: {.thm-box}
**The Higher-Order Triad of $\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}$:**
1. **Hypermetrophor (${}^1\mathbf{w}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}} \equiv (\mathbf{y}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}}_i)_N$):** Encapsulates $N$ complete base Syntrices from $T0$ as 0-dimensional objects.
2. **Metroplexsynkolator (${}^1\mathfrak{f} \equiv S(2)$):** Second-order Syntrixfunktor correlating entire Syntrixfelder.
3. **Synkolationsstufe ($r$):** Functorial valency binding $r$ component Syntrices per step, terminating at the **Nullmetroplex (${}^1\mathbf{M}_0$)**.
:::
:::

::: {.intuition-box .fragment}
**Higher Corporate Pairings (SM Eqs. 20a, 20b):**
Hypersyntrices pair via higher-order Metroplexkorporatoren into **concentric** ($\overline{|B|}$, SM-20a) or **excentric** ($\overline{||}$, SM-20b) networks, inheriting higher-order *Spaltbarkeit* and the 4 elementary pyramidal structures.
:::
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
Chapter 5 solves the multi-scale problem. How does an entire network of lower-level systems become a single atomic building block at the next organizational scale? Heim's Hypersyntrix M^1 encapsulates N base Syntrices into its Hypermetrophor, replicating the entire operational grammar of Chapters 2 and 3 at a higher categorical type.
:::

## §5.1.2–5.1.5: Higher *Metroplexe* ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}$), Bridges & *Diabatik* {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: METROPLEX RECURSION (SM EQS. 21–26) &amp; DUALE TEKTONIK</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Recursive Grade-$n$ Hierarchy (SM Eqs. 21–24, p. 89):**
$$
\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \equiv \overset{\scriptscriptstyle 0}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}, \qquad \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n+1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \equiv \big\langle \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{F}},\, \overset{\scriptscriptstyle\sim}{\mathbf{M}}{}^n\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}\,\underline{\mathrm{r}} \big\rangle, \qquad S(n+1) \equiv {}^n\mathfrak{f} \tag{SM-21..24}
$$
* **Protosimplexe (SM, p. 87):** Minimal, non-decomposable configurations in $T_n$ serving as atomic generators for grade $n+1$.
* **Duale Endogene Tektonik (SM, p. 93):**
  1. **Graduelle Tektonik (Vertical):** Nested hierarchy across grades $0 \le k \le n-1$.
  2. **Syndromatische Tektonik (Horizontal):** Within-grade syndrome layers generated by ${}^k\mathfrak{f}$.
* **Kontraktion ($\kappa \colon \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}} \to \overset{\scriptscriptstyle m}{\mathbf{M}}',\; m < n$):** Compresses complexity while preserving dominant invariants.
:::
:::

<div class="video-container">

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Syntrokline Brücken (SM-25) & Metroplexdiabatik (SM, p. 103):**
* Totalities $T_n$ are *Etagen* (floors); **Syntrokline Brücken (${}^{n+N}\alpha$, SM-25a)** are *Aufzüge* (elevators) lifting lower syndromes into higher Hypermetrophors.
* Combining inward **Metrophoric Diabatik ($\gamma=0$)** with outward **Syndromatic Diabatik ($\gamma>0$)** closes a **syntrokline Rückkoppelung** (re-entrant feedback loop).
:::
:::

## §5.2.1–5.2.3: The Ambient $(\infty, 1)$-Topos $\Xsyn$ & $\dCSeg(\Xsyn)$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: GROTHENDIECK UNIVERSES (FIG. 5.2) &amp; DENDROIDAL SEGAL SPACES (PROP. 5.3)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 5.1: Ambient $(\infty, 1)$-Topos $\Xsyn$ & Universe Safety**
Fix Grothendieck universes $\mathcal{U}_0 \in \mathcal{U}_1 \in \mathcal{U}_2$ and $\mathcal{S} \coloneqq \mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{U}_0}$. Instead of proliferating sites at every grade, all Metroplexe inhabit a single $\mathcal{U}_0$-presentable $(\infty, 1)$-topos (Lurie 2009):
$$
\Xsyn \;\coloneqq\; \mathbf{Sh}_\infty\big(\Ctx, \Jsyn\big) \;\coloneqq\; L_{\Jsyn}\!\Big(\operatorname{Fun}\big((\Ctx)^{\mathrm{op}}, \mathcal{S}\big)\Big)
$$
Every internal Metroplex $\mathbf{M}^n$ is $\mathcal{U}_0$-small inside $\Xsyn$, while $\Met_n(\Xsyn) \in \mathcal{U}_1$ and external functor slices reside in $\mathcal{U}_2$.
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Definition 5.2 & Proposition 5.3: Dendroidal Complete Segal Spaces**
Over the Moerdijk–Weiss tree category $\mathbf{\Omega}$ ($i \colon \mathbf{\Delta} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{\Omega}$), $\Met_1(\Xsyn) \coloneqq \dCSeg(\Xsyn) \subset \operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf{\Omega}^{\mathrm{op}}, \Xsyn)$ satisfies:

1. **Dendroidal Segal Grafting Equivalence:** For binary grafting $T = C_2^{(v)} \circ_e C_2^{(u)}$ along inner edge $\eta_e$:
$$
X(T) \;\xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\; X(C_2^{(v)}) \mathop{\times}\limits^{\mathrm{h}}_{X(\eta_e)} X(C_2^{(u)})
$$
2. **Rezk Completeness:** $(i^*X)_0 \xrightarrow{\sim} (i^*X)_{\mathrm{hoequiv}} \subset (i^*X)_1$.
:::
:::

::: {.intuition-box .fragment}
**Assumption 5.4 (Graded Operadic System $\{\On\}_{n\ge 0}$):**
Transition morphisms $\phi_{n,n+1} \colon \On \to \mathcal{O}_{n+1}$ induce free-forgetful adjunctions $\Free_{\On} \dashv U_n$ and change-of-operad adjunctions $(\phi_{n,n+1})_! \dashv (\phi_{n,n+1})^*$.
:::

## §5.3.1–5.3.3: Transcendence Tower, Bridges & Postnikov $\tau_{\le m}$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: BRIDGE ADJUNCTIONS (PROP. 5.8) &amp; HOMOTOPY CONTRACTION (DEF. 5.9, FIGS. 5.1–5.4)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definitions 5.5–5.7 & Proposition 5.8: Syntroclinic Bridge Adjunction**
* For $n \ge 1$, the Hypermetrophor is a simplicial diagram $H_n \colon \mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}} \to \Met_{n-1}(\Xsyn)$ with colimit $\HypMet_n \coloneqq \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}}(U_{n-1}^{\Met} \circ H_n)$ generating $\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\mathcal{S} \coloneqq \Free_{\On}(\HypMet_n)$.
* The **Syntroclinic Bridge** is the left adjoint extension-of-scalars functor:
$$
B_{n, n+N} \coloneqq (\phi_{n, n+N})_! \;\dashv\; (\phi_{n, n+N})^* =: R_{n+N, n}
$$
$B_{n, n+N}|_{\mathcal{I}_n}$ is **fully faithful** iff the unit $\eta_X \colon X \xrightarrow{\sim} R_{n+N, n}(B_{n, n+N}(X))$ is an equivalence!
:::

## §5.3.4: Bisimplicial Tectonic Grid & Dold–Kan Realization $\mathfrak{R}_{\mathrm{Ban}}$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: 2-FOLD SEGAL DIAGONAL REALIZATION (DEFS. 5.11–5.12 &amp; THM. 5.13, FIG. 5.5)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 5.11 & Theorem 5.13: Tectonic Diagonal Realization**
The internal architecture of an associative Metroplex $\mathcal{S} \in \Met_n(\Xsyn)$ is a bisimplicial object $\Tect(\mathcal{S}) \in \operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}} \times \mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}, \Xsyn)$:
* **Vertical Axis ($\operatorname{Gr}_\bullet$, $d_j^v$):** Graduelle Tektonik across lower grades $0 \le k \le n-1$.
* **Horizontal Axis ($\operatorname{Syn}_\bullet$, $d_i^h$):** Syndromatische Tektonik within each grade.
* **Total Tectonic Space (Diagonal Colimit Equivalence):**
$$
\big|\Tect(\mathcal{S})\big|_{\mathbf{\Delta}} \;\coloneqq\; \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}}\big(\operatorname{diag}^* \Tect(\mathcal{S})\big) \;\simeq\; \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}} \times \mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}} \Tect(\mathcal{S})_{p,q}
$$
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Definition 5.12: Homological Banach Realization Functor $\mathfrak{R}_{\mathrm{Ban}}$**
Via the Dold–Kan equivalence $N_\bullet \colon s\mathbf{Vect}_{\mathbb{R}} \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathbf{Ch}_{\ge 0}(\mathbf{Vect}_{\mathbb{R}})$:
$$
\mathfrak{R}_{\mathrm{Ban}}(X) \;\coloneqq\; \bigoplus_{k=0}^\infty H_k\!\Big(N_\bullet\big(\mathbb{R}[\Gamma(X)]\big)\Big)_{\ell^1} \;\in\; \operatorname{Obj}(\FinBan)
$$
Degree $k=0$ recovers $\mathbb{R}[\pi_0(\Gamma(X))]$, while $k \ge 1$ preserves higher homotopy!
:::
:::

## §5.3.5: Cohesive Modalities ($\int \dashv \flat \dashv \sharp$) & Spectral Sequence {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: LAWVERE–SCHREIBER COHESION (DEF. 5.14) &amp; METROPLEXDIABATIK (THM. 5.15)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 5.14: Cohesive $(\infty, 1)$-Topos Structure on $\Xsyn$**
Extending $\Gamma \colon \Xsyn \to \mathcal{S}$ to the adjoint quadruple $\Pi \dashv \Disc \dashv \Gamma \dashv \Codisc$ induces the internal **cohesive modality triple** $\int \dashv \flat \dashv \sharp$:
$$
\int \coloneqq \Disc \circ \Pi \;\;(\text{Shape / Äondyne}), \quad \flat \coloneqq \Disc \circ \Gamma \;\;(\text{Discrete Skeleton}), \quad \sharp \coloneqq \Codisc \circ \Gamma
$$
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Theorem 5.15 & Carnap 5.1: Tectonic Spectral Sequence & Downward Causation**
Filtering the Dold–Kan bicomplex $C_{p,q}(\mathcal{S})$ by vertical grade $p$ yields a convergent first-quadrant spectral sequence:
$$
E^2_{p,q} = H_p^{\mathrm{grad}}\!\Big(H_q^{\mathrm{syn}}\big(C_{\bullet,\bullet}(\mathcal{S})\big)\Big) \;\Longrightarrow\; H_{p+q}\!\Big(\big|\Tect_{\mathbf{Ban}}(\mathcal{S})\big|_{\mathbf{\Delta}}\Big)
$$
with transgression differentials $d^r \colon E^r_{p,q} \to E^r_{p-r,\, q+r-1}$ ($r \ge 2$).
* **$d^r \equiv 0\;\forall r \ge 2$:** Purely adiabatic (decoupled scales).
* **$d^r \ne 0$:** Exact homological signature of **Metroplexdiabatik** (resolving Kim's downward causation exclusion problem via global cohomology selection!).
:::
:::

## §5.3.6–5.3.7: *Protosimplexe* & The Endogenous $EN$-Product {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A/B: SUBOBJECT-MINIMAL PROTOSIMPLEXE (DEF. 5.17) &amp; EN-OPERATOR (DEF. 5.18)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definitions 5.16–5.17: Slice Totality $T_n$ & *Protosimplexe***
The state totality of grade-$n$ realizations over blueprint $G_n$ is the slice category $T_n \coloneqq \Met_n(\Xsyn) / G_n$ (with terminal object $\operatorname{id}_{G_n}$ and initial *Nullmetroplex* ${}^n\mathbf{M}_0 = (0_n \to G_n)$).
An object $\mathcal{P} \in \operatorname{Obj}(T_n)$ is a **Protosimplex of Grade $n$** if $\mathcal{P} \not\cong \Free_{\On}(\emptyset)$ and has **no proper non-trivial augmented sub-algebras**:
$$
\forall A \hookrightarrow \mathcal{P} \text{ in } \Alg_{\On}^0,\qquad A \cong \Free_{\On}(\emptyset) \;\vee\; A \cong \mathcal{P}
$$
:::

::: {.thm-box .fragment}
**Definition 5.18: Endogenous Synthesis & Absorption ($EN$-Product, SM-26)**
1. **Endogenous Synthesis:** $\operatorname{SynEN}_{p,q}^n \colon \Met_p \times \Met_q \to \Met_n$ ($p + q = n,\; q > 0$).
2. **Tectonic Absorption:** $\operatorname{AbsEN}_n^{p+q} \colon \Met_n \times \Met_{p+q} \to \Met_n$ ($p + q \le n,\; q > 0$).
:::
:::

## §5.4–5.6: Reconstruction Map $\mathcal{R}$, Sanity Checks & Synthesis {.smaller}

**Physical & Epistemic Sanity Checks (§5.5):**
1. **Grade-0 Recovery ($n = 0$):** $\Met_0(\Xsyn) \equiv \Alg_{\mathcal{O}_0}(\Xsyn) \cong \mathbf{Syn}$ (recovers Chapter 2 without higher nesting).
2. **0-Truncation Set Collapse ($m = 0$):** $\tau_{\le 0}X \simeq \underline{\pi}_0(X)$ discards higher homotopical self-reflections, recovering classical set-theoretic modeling as the 0-truncated shadow of $\Xsyn$.

<!-- JAVASCRIPT FOR CHAPTER 5 INTERACTIVE LABORATORIES -->
<script>
function updatePostnikov() {
  let m = parseInt(document.getElementById('post-m').value);
  let lbl = document.getElementById('post-m-val');
  let path = document.getElementById('post-path');
  let pt0 = document.getElementById('post-pt0');
  let box = document.getElementById('post-readout');

  if (m === 0) {
    lbl.innerText = "m = 0";
    path.setAttribute('d', '');
    pt0.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>0-Truncation τ_{≤0} X ≃ π₀(X) (Set Collapse, §5.5.2):</b></span><br>` +
      `All higher homotopy groups vanish (π_{k≥1} = 0). Collapses the homotopy type to its discrete sheaf of connected components!`;
  } else {
    pt0.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    lbl.innerText = (m === 3) ? "m = ∞" : `m = ${m}`;
    let amp = (m === 1) ? 0.0 : (m === 2 ? 8.0 : 20.0);
    let freq = (m === 2) ? 6 : 14;
    let pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
      let t = (i / 120.0) * 2.0 * Math.PI;
      let rx = 95 + amp * Math.sin(freq * t);
      let ry = 55 + amp * Math.cos(freq * t);
      let x = 210 + rx * Math.cos(t);
      let y = 78 + ry * Math.sin(t);
      pts.push((i === 0 ? "M " : "L ") + x.toFixed(1) + "," + y.toFixed(1));
    }
    pts.push("Z");
    path.setAttribute('d', pts.join(" "));
    path.setAttribute('stroke', m === 1 ? "#20B2AA" : (m === 2 ? "#FFA500" : "#DC143C"));

    if (m === 1) {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>1-Truncation τ_{≤1} X (Fundamental Groupoid):</b></span><br>` +
        `Preserves π₀(X) and fundamental group loops π₁(X), while extinguishing all higher homotopy noise (π_{k≥2} = 0)!`;
    } else if (m === 2) {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFA500";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFA500;"><b>2-Truncation τ_{≤2} X (2-Type Approximation):</b></span><br>` +
        `Retains π₀, π₁, and 2-dimensional surface homotopy π₂(X); filters out all k ≥ 3 fluctuations.`;
    } else {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>Untruncated Object X ∈ X_syn (Full ∞-Groupoid):</b></span><br>` +
        `Contains arbitrarily high microscopic homotopy fluctuations π_k(X) across all degrees k ≥ 1.`;
    }
  }
}

let currentTectMode = 'diag';

function setTectMode(mode) {
  currentTectMode = mode;
  let svg = document.getElementById('tect-svg');
  let html = '';

  // Draw horizontal and vertical grid lines
  for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
    for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
      let x = 75 + p * 90;
      let y = 155 - q * 42;
      if (p < 3) {
        let col = (mode === 'syn') ? '#4169E1' : '#2d3748';
        let w = (mode === 'syn') ? 3.2 : 1.5;
        html += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${y}" x2="${x+90}" y2="${y}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"/>`;
      }
      if (q < 3) {
        let col = (mode === 'grad') ? '#20B2AA' : '#2d3748';
        let w = (mode === 'grad') ? 3.2 : 1.5;
        html += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${y}" x2="${x}" y2="${y-42}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"/>`;
      }
    }
  }

  if (mode === 'diag') {
    html += `<line x1="75" y1="155" x2="345" y2="29" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>`;
  }

  for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
    for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
      let x = 75 + p * 90;
      let y = 155 - q * 42;
      let isDiag = (p === q);
      let fill = '#1e293b';
      let stroke = '#4169E1';
      let r = 13;
      if (mode === 'diag' && isDiag) { fill = '#FFD700'; stroke = '#fff'; r = 16; }
      else if (mode === 'syn') { fill = '#4169E1'; stroke = '#fff'; }
      else if (mode === 'grad') { fill = '#20B2AA'; stroke = '#fff'; }

      let txtCol = (mode === 'diag' && isDiag) ? '#000' : '#fff';
      html += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
      html += `<text x="${x}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${txtCol}" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">S_${p},${q}</text>`;
    }
  }

  svg.innerHTML = html;
  let box = document.getElementById('tect-readout');
  if (mode === 'diag') {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>Diagonal Realization |Tect(S)|_Δ (Thm. 5.13):</b></span> colim_{Δ^op}(diag* Tect(S)) ≃ colim_{Δ^op × Δ^op} S_{p,q} unifies vertical and horizontal tectonics!`;
  } else if (mode === 'syn') {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#4169E1";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#82aaff;"><b>Horizontal Axis Syn_• (d_i^h):</b></span> Syndromatische Tektonik—within-grade syndrome layers generated by operadic composition ^k f.`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#5eead4;"><b>Vertical Axis Gr_• (d_j^v):</b></span> Graduelle Tektonik—nested compositional filtration across associated lower Metroplex grades 0 ≤ p ≤ n-1.`;
  }
}

function setSpecPage(r) {
  let d2 = document.getElementById('ss-d2');
  let d3 = document.getElementById('ss-d3');
  let box = document.getElementById('ss-readout');

  if (r === 2) {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>E²-Page Active (d² : E²_{p,q} → E²_{p-2, q+1} ≠ 0):</b></span> First-order <b>Metroplexdiabatik</b>—a grade-p structure injects a non-trivial boundary 2 grades down into syndrome level q + 1!`;
  } else if (r === 3) {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '0.2');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>E³-Page Active (d³ : E³_{3,0} → E³_{0,2} ≠ 0):</b></span> Deep cross-scale <b>Metroplexdiabatik</b>—transgressing 3 vertical Metroplex grades into syndrome level q + 2!`;
  } else {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>Adiabatic Decoupled Limit (d^r ≡ 0 for all r ≥ 2):</b></span> Spectral sequence degenerates at E² = E^∞; scales evolve without cross-grade diabatic feedback.`;
  }
}

function updateENLab() {
  let n = parseInt(document.getElementById('en-n').value);
  let p = parseInt(document.getElementById('en-p').value);
  let q = parseInt(document.getElementById('en-q').value);
  document.getElementById('en-n-val').innerText = n;
  document.getElementById('en-p-val').innerText = p;
  document.getElementById('en-q-val').innerText = q;

  let sum = p + q;
  let box = document.getElementById('en-readout');

  if (q <= 0) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>✗ VIOLATES POSITIVITY (q = ${q} ≤ 0):</b></span> SM Eq. 26 and Lean 4 <code>pos_shift : 0 &lt; q</code> require strictly positive shift grade q &gt; 0!`;
  } else if (sum > n) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>✗ VIOLATES GRADE BOUND (p + q = ${sum} &gt; n = ${n}):</b></span> Exceeds ambient Metroplex grade n; triggers recursive grade runaway!`;
  } else if (sum === n) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>✓ EXACT ENDOGENOUS SYNTHESIS (p + q = ${sum} = n, q = ${q} &gt; 0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Activates <b>SynEN_{${p},${q}}^{${n}} : Met_${p} × Met_${q} → Met_${n}</b> (and <b>AbsEN_${n}^{${sum}}</b>)!`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>✓ ADMISSIBLE TECTONIC ABSORPTION (p + q = ${sum} &lt; n = ${n}, q = ${q} &gt; 0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Satisfies Lean 4 <code>EndogenousAdmissible ${n} ${p} ${q}</code>; activates <b>AbsEN_${n}^{${sum}} : Met_${n} × Met_${sum} → Met_${n}</b>!`;
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  updatePostnikov();
  setTectMode('diag');
  updateENLab();
});
</script>
